name: git-sandbox
title_zh: 沙箱里给 Agent 用的 Git 工作流协议
tagline_zh: Agent 在沙箱里改代码，分支乱、冲突卡死、交互弹窗？这套协议让 Git 全程静默、非交互、本地闭环。
tagline_en: Agents stuck in sandbox Git hell—interactive prompts, branch chaos, merge deadlocks? This protocol keeps Git.
desc_en: Git workflow protocol for agents in sandbox/worktree environments. Covers local-only operations, worktree-aware branch management, and non-interactive conflict resolution. Injected only for git-associated workspaces.
why_zh: 不是命令集合，是工作流约束：强制 worktree 感知、只走本地操作、冲突自动降级为可解析格式。
why_en: Not a command list—a constraint system: worktree-aware, local-only, conflicts auto-degrade to parseable output, so the agent.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 git 关联工作区，且仅限本地操作；不处理远程推送、认证、子模块递归。遇到交互式 rebase 或复杂三方合并。
limit_en: Only for git-linked workspaces, local ops only; no push/auth/submodule recursion. Interactive rebase or complex 3-way merges abort and defer to human.
